jobs.title: Reconciliation Infrastructure Associate
jobs.description:
About Payoneer
Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We’re a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.
By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.
Reconciliation Infrastructure Associate
Hybrid
Full-time
Role Summary
You will join Payoneer's Reconciliation team as a hands-on owner of BlackLine, the system that reconciles around a million transactions a day from hundreds of data sources. You'll handle day-to-day system support, configure new flows as the business evolves, and work closely with our offshore investigation team and our accounting reconciliation team. This is a role for a systems-minded person with a feel for numbers who thrives in a fast-moving environment and wants to grow at the intersection of finance and technology.
What You'll Do
- Own daily BlackLine support: handle tickets, troubleshoot issues and keep reconciliations flowing
- Configure and maintain the system to support new flows, products and a fast-changing business
- Support our offshore investigation team when data or processes in the system break or go missing
- Review system outputs with the accounting reconciliation team, including journal entries
- Take part in month, quarter and year-end close activities
- Translate business needs into system solutions and lead process improvements and automation
- Analyze anomalies, raise red flags and escalate issues when needed
Who You Are
- A. in Economics or a related field
- 2-4 years of experience, beyond a first role
- Hands-on experience working with business systems (e.g., ERP, operational or reconciliation systems)
- A strong grasp of numbers and a basic understanding of accounting
- Fluent English, spoken and written, for daily work with international teams
- Able to manage several tasks at once and meet tight deadlines, especially during closing periods
- Flexible, resilient under pressure and eager to learn in a dynamic environment
- Experience with BlackLine or other reconciliation systems is a strong advantage
- Involvement in a system implementation or go-live project is an advantage
The Payoneer Ways of Working 
Act as our customer’s partner on the inside 
Learning what they need and creating what will help them go further. 
Do it. Own it. 
Being fearlessly accountable in everything we do. 
Continuously improve 
Always striving for a higher standard than our last. 
Build each other up 
Helping each other grow, as professionals and people. 
If this sounds like a business, a community, and a mission you want to be part of, apply today.
We are committed to providing a diverse and inclusive workplace. Payoneer is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment no matter your race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. jobs.title: Data Analyst- Product Data & AI Quality
jobs.description:
Data Analyst – Product Data & AI Quality
At Similarweb, we are revolutionizing the way businesses interact with the digital world by revealing to them everything that happens online. 
Our unique data and solutions empower thousands of customers globally, including industry giants like Google, eBay, and Adidas, to make game-changing decisions that drive their digital strategies.
In 2021, we went public on the New York Stock Exchange, and we continue to reach new heights! Come work alongside Similarwebbers across the globe who are bright, curious, practical, and good people.
We’re looking for a Data Analyst to join our R&D department!
Why is this role so important at Similarweb?
Our Retail Intelligence products help leading brands and retailers understand how their products, brands and categories perform online. Behind them is data collected from retailers and marketplaces around the world, each describing products in its own way. We use LLMs and ML models to classify, normalize and structure that data into a single, trusted view.
As a Data Analyst on the team, you’ll be the person who knows this data best. You’ll own its quality: defining what “correct” looks like, building the ground truth our models are measured against, and finding where things break and why. You’ll work closely with the engineers and scientists who build our LLM and ML pipelines, and with Product, turning what you find into clear priorities. Your work will also directly support our customers: partnering with our customer-facing teams on deep-dive analyses, and investigating and fixing the data gaps that matter most to clients.
It’s a role for someone curious and hands-on, who enjoys digging into data, uses AI tools to move faster, and wants to see their analysis directly shape the product.
So, what will you be doing all day?
Your daily responsibilities may include:
- Analyzing product, brand and category data to find gaps, errors and opportunities to improve coverage and accuracy
- Defining quality metrics and building the dashboards and checks that track them over time
- Building and maintaining ground-truth datasets and labeling guidelines, and running labeling processes
- Evaluating the output of LLM and ML models: error analysis, comparing approaches, and turning findings into concrete improvements
- Using LLMs and AI tools to speed up analysis, labeling and data review
- Helping define and maintain taxonomies and classification rules together with Product
- Supporting client-related needs with our customer-facing teams, from in-depth analyses of specific market segments to investigating and fixing data gaps raised by clients
- Validating new data sources before they are added to the product
- Partnering with Product and engineering to translate findings into requirements and priorities
This is the perfect job for someone who:
- Holds a B.Sc. in Industrial Engineering, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science or another quantitative field
- Has 2+ years of experience as a data analyst, preferably in a tech company
- Has strong SQL skills
- Uses Python for data analysis (pandas, notebooks) - Must
- Has a solid understanding of statistics and evaluation metrics: sampling, precision/recall, confidence levels
- Has hands-on experience using LLMs for data work, such as prompting, structured outputs or reviewing model outputs
- Has strong attention to detail and a structured approach to messy, ambiguous data
- Communicates clearly in English and can present findings to Product, engineering and customer-facing teams
- Has experience with labeling, taxonomies or data quality processes (advantage)
- Has experience with e-commerce or product data (advantage)
- Has experience with BI and visualization tools (advantage)

You’ll actually love the product you work with: Our customers aren’t our only raving fans. When we asked our employees why they chose to come work at Similarweb, 99% of them said “the product.” Imagine how exciting your job is when you get to work with the most powerful digital intelligence platform in the world.
You’ll find a home for your big ideas: We encourage an open dialogue and empower employees to bring their ideas to the table. You’ll find the resources you need to take initiative and create meaningful change within the organization.

So, what’s the role all about?
NiCE is seeking an HR Operations specialist to join our Global HR Operations team in Israel. 
This role will play a key role in driving process excellence, operational efficiency, and continuous improvement across Global HR Operations. The successful candidate will partner closely with HR Operations, HRIS, Talent Acquisition, Payroll, and Shared Services teams to identify process improvement opportunities, optimize workflows, strengthen operational governance, improve data quality, and leverage technology to enhance the employee experience and scale HR service delivery globally.

How will you make an impact? 
Process Improvement & Operational Excellence 
- Analyze HR processes to identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, service gaps, and recurring issues. 
- Drive continuous improvement initiatives across employee lifecycle processes. 
- Create and maintain SOPs, process documentation, governance controls, and operational playbooks. 
- Conduct root-cause analysis and recommend sustainable solutions to improve operational performance. 
Global Employee Lifecycle Management

- Maintain employee records and documentation in compliance with company policies and regulatory requirements. 
HR Systems & Service Delivery 
- Partner with HRIS, Payroll, Talent Acquisition, and IT teams to optimize HR workflows and system processes. 
- Support enhancements within Oracle HCM, ServiceNow, and related HR technologies. 
- Monitor service delivery metrics and identify opportunities to improve SLA performance and employee experience. 
- Promote adoption of standardized processes and case management best practices. 
Data Governance & Analytics 
- Maintain high standards of HR data quality and integrity. 
- Perform audits and data validation activities to identify and resolve discrepancies. 
- Leverage reporting tools and operational metrics to generate insights and recommendations for HR leadership. 
Have you got what it takes? 
- 2-4 years of experience in HR Operations, HR Shared Services, HRIS, or related HR functions within a global enterprise organization. 
- Demonstrated experience driving process improvements and operational efficiencies. 
- Strong understanding of employee lifecycle processes, HR operations, and service delivery models. 
- Experience working with enterprise HR systems such as Oracle HCM, Workday, or SAP SuccessFactors. 
- Experience working with case management or ticketing platforms such as ServiceNow. 
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and root-cause analysis skills. 
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. 
- Fluent English, written and verbal. 
Preferred Qualifications 
- Experience working in a complex global environment. 
- Experience with process mapping, workflow design, and continuous improvement methodologies. 
- Strong reporting and analytics capabilities using Power BI, Excel, or similar tools. 
- Experience supporting automation, system enhancements, or digital transformation initiatives. 
- Familiarity with HR operational governance, quality assurance, and service delivery metrics.

Join an ever-growing, market disrupting, global company where the teams – comprised of the best of the best – work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! As the market leader, every day at NiCE is a chance to learn and grow, and there are endless internal career opportunities across multiple roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. jobs.title: Decision Analyst
jobs.description:
About the role:
As a Decision Analyst at Forter, you will own one of the company’s most critical assets: the accuracy, robustness, and performance of what is widely recognized as the leading e-commerce fraud decisioning system in the industry.
You will be expected to think creatively and push boundaries, constantly improving how we identify fraud and protect legitimate customers. You will design logical and technical solutions to real, constantly evolving challenges faced by some of the world’s largest online retailers. Your work will operate at the intersection of deep data research, real-time production decisioning systems, and real-world impact.
This position has strong technical and analytical depth, but you don’t need prior coding experience. With agentic tools like Claude Code and our structured training, candidates that are a strong fit can close any technical gaps quickly. We hire across multiple levels and adjust the scope and level of ownership based on what we learn during the interview process.
You will join Forter’s Decision Science and Analytics department, a high-bar, fast-moving group with a strong culture of excellence, curiosity, and ownership. We work in an informal, collaborative environment where strong opinions are welcome and great ideas move fast. The role offers meaningful growth opportunities, with clear paths toward both senior individual contributor and managerial roles, allowing you to shape your career based on your strengths.
Your work will directly shape Forter’s product, protect hundreds of millions of consumers, and help define the future of trust in digital commerce.
What you'll be doing:
- Invent, design, implement, and continuously refine the core decisioning logic and models that run in Forter’s live production systems
- Research complex fraud patterns, adversarial behaviors, and emerging threats
- Leverage rich and diverse datasets to generate actionable insights, build new system components, and advance feature engineering efforts
- Use agentic tools such as Claude Code to develop automatic tools and processes that improve the accuracy, scalability, and efficiency of our systems
- Collaborate closely with Engineers, Product Managers, and business stakeholders to build the next generation of Forter’s AI-driven technology
What you'll need:
- Psychometric score above 700 or equivalent (e.g. GMAT) - we use this as a baseline measure of structured reasoning and analytical speed
- A record of high achievement, in whatever form that's taken in your life - academic, professional, military, or otherwise
- Strong analytical and logical reasoning skills, with a proven ability to break down and solve highly complex problems
- Strong technical orientation. Experience with Python, SQL, or R is an advantage but not required. You should be comfortable learning new tools and technologies
- Excellent communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain complex technical ideas and research outcomes to a wide range of audiences
- Natural curiosity and the ability to understand systemic behaviors and adversarial tactics
- Proactive and results-driven mindset, with the ability to work independently within a collaborative team
- Experience building things with AI: agentic workflows, apps, automations. Bring an example you built and can walk us through. You should be enthusiastic about and comfortable with agentic tools.
Bonus points for:
- Experience with SQL or Python
- Familiarity with machine learning concepts
- Background in risk analysis, intelligence, or adversarial research
About us:
Commerce is evolving faster than the systems built to support it. Agentic AI is redrawing how people buy. Customer expectations have a new ceiling. And bad actors are evolving alongside every advancement. 
Forter was built to meet this moment — and stay ahead of it.
We are a human-first, AI-built company. Our technology analyzes patterns across a network of over 2 billion shoppers, delivering identity intelligence across the entire commerce journey — from sign-up to checkout to returns — that protects revenue and unlocks great customer experiences simultaneously. With Forter, businesses know who to trust, whether it’s humans or the agents shopping for them. The result: zero friction for the customers who matter. No revenue left behind.
The world's most trusted brands — Nordstrom, Instacart, Priceline, Adobe, ASOS, and eBay among them — rely on Forter to get this right. Since 2013, we've raised $525M from investors including Tiger Global, Bessemer, Sequoia Capital, and Salesforce Ventures, and today we power commerce decisions for nearly 1 million businesses globally. We're more than fraud, payments and orchestration – we make trust a competitive advantage.
Trust is backed by data – Forter is a recipient of over 10 workplace and innovation awards, including: 
- Great Place to Work Certification (2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025)
- Fortune’s Best Workplaces in NYC (2022, 2023, 2024 and 2025)
- Forbes Cloud 100 (2021, 2022, 2023, 2024 and 2025)
- Anti-Fraud Solution of the Year at the Payments Awards (2024)
Life as a Forterian:
Forterians are, genuinely, some of the best people you'll work with. Smart, curious, and deeply good humans who care about the work and each other. That's not an accident — it's something we've been intentional about since day one, and it's the thing people mention most when they talk about why they stay. When you're surrounded by people like this, doing work that actually matters, it changes what a job can feel like.
Forter was built on a simple but powerful conviction: when AI does its job, humans can do theirs better. That philosophy shapes our products and shapes how we work. AI is core to our workflows — not as a shortcut, but as a force multiplier that gives Forterians the space to focus their energy where human judgment is irreplaceable.
We're a global team of 500+ people, with regional headquarters in New York, Tel Aviv, London, and Singapore, and employee presence across the US, Canada, Germany, France, Japan, China, and Australia. Our teams are cross-functional by design, and the work you do here is visible, consequential, and connected to the outcomes that matter.
You'll have real ownership here and proximity to decisions. And we back that with investment in your growth — RSU offerings, L&D programs built around AI tools, and a culture of recognition rooted in our 4.5 day weeks (aka Forter’s Appreciation Fridays and Sundays). From team outings to local cultural celebrations, we mark the moments that matter — wherever you are in the world. We don't want Forter to be just another job. We want it to be the place you build.
If you're ready to work on a problem that sits at the intersection of AI, commerce, and human trust, this is it.
Forter is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer that will consider all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, marital status, gender identity or expression, national origin, genetics, age, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please email us at interviewaccommodation@forter.com. This information will be treated as confidential and used only for the purpose of determining an appropriate accommodation for the interview process.
Hybrid work:
At Forter, we embrace a hybrid work model that blends in-person connection with the flexibility of remote work. Team members based near our key hubs are expected to work from the office at least three days per week. We believe that regular face-to-face collaboration fuels professional development, strengthens our culture, and builds the relationships that help teams thrive.

Support G&A operations 20%

Requirements

jobs.title: NetSuite Administrator
jobs.description:
Description
This is us 
Kaltura (NYSE: KLTR) is a global software company on a mission to transform digital experiences from one-way interactions into intelligent, personalized conversations that move people forward.
Founded in 2006, we started by making video more accessible to organizations around the world. Today, we're taking that foundation much further, combining conversational AI, rich media, enterprise knowledge, and data to build a new generation of intelligent digital experiences.
Our technology helps organizations turn their content and knowledge into interactive, AI-powered experiences that can guide customers, train employees, support learners, and engage audiences in real time. From AI agents and personalized learning experiences to digital events, content hubs, and media platforms, we're changing how people interact with technology, and what technology can do for them.
More than 1,000 organizations worldwide rely on Kaltura, reaching over 100 million users at home, at work, and at school.
And the people behind it? We're a global team of 600+ employees, with offices in New York, London, Singapore, and Tel Aviv, united by a culture of openness, flexibility, and collaboration. Kaltura is a fast-paced environment where ideas are welcome, initiative is encouraged, and there's always something new to build, challenge, or improve. We believe in giving people the freedom to make an impact, the flexibility to balance work and life, and the opportunity to grow as we continue to evolve.
If you don't meet 100% of the requirements below, that's okay. Nobody's perfect! We believe in hiring people, not just a list of skills. If this sounds like a place where you'd be excited to learn, contribute, and make an impact, we'd love to hear from you.
Requirements
The role 
We are seeking an experienced NetSuite Administrator to join our Finance Systems team. In this role, you will be responsible for supporting, optimizing, and scaling our NetSuite ERP environment while partnering closely with Corporate Accounting and cross-functional stakeholders. You will play a key role in NetSuite implementation and expansion initiatives, finance process automation, systems integration, and continuous improvement efforts across our Finance technology ecosystem.
This is an exciting opportunity for a hands-on professional who combines strong NetSuite expertise with a solid understanding of accounting and finance processes, helping drive operational efficiency, scalability, and business growth.
 The day-to-day
- Administer, maintain, and optimize the NetSuite platform, ensuring system stability, performance, security, and scalability.
- Partner with Corporate Accounting, Finance, and business stakeholders to improve processes, strengthen controls, and maximize system utilization.
- Configure and maintain NetSuite workflows, saved searches, reports, dashboards, roles, and permissions to support evolving business needs.
- Support NetSuite implementation and enhancement initiatives, including data migration, data conversion, testing, deployment, and post-go-live optimization.
- Support and maintain integrations across the Finance technology ecosystem, with a particular focus on Salesforce (SFDC) and other critical business applications.
- Drive automation and continuous improvement initiatives to streamline month-end close, financial reporting, and operational finance processes.
- Troubleshoot system issues, support end users, maintain documentation, and collaborate with global teams across multiple regions and time zones.
﻿Ideally, we’re looking for:
- Hands-on experience administering NetSuite, including configuration, workflows, saved searches, reporting, dashboards, roles, and permissions.
- Strong understanding of Accounting and Finance processes, including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Revenue Recognition, and Month-End Close.
- Experience supporting ERP implementations, system enhancements, integrations, and data migration or conversion initiatives.
- Experience supporting Salesforce (SFDC) integrations and related quote-to-cash or finance business processes.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across global cross-functional teams.
These would also be nice: 
- CPA certification and/or a degree in Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, or a related field.
- Experience working in a SOX-compliant environment and supporting publicly traded or SaaS companies.
- Experience with SuiteFlow, SuiteAnalytics, AI-enabled tools, FP&A platforms, budgeting, forecasting, planning, or other Finance technology applications.
 The perks: 
- Hybrid, flexible work environment 
- Extended private health (including mental) insurance 
- Personal and professional development programs 
- Occasional Cross company long weekends

Requirements
- CPA qualification and significant experience as a controller or assistant controller at a technology company — required.
- Deep familiarity with how a technology company’s finance function operates, including close and reporting, revenue recognition, controls, financial systems and business stakeholders.
- Personal experience leading improvements or change within a finance function, such as accelerating the close, improving reporting, implementing a system or automating processes — required.
- Ability to engage credibly with finance leaders, identify a business need and translate it into a solution and a clear proposal.
- Business initiative, relationship-building skills and a desire to help develop the practice’s activity and client base.
- A strong technological orientation and the ability to work with systems, data and automation specialists.
- Experience with global operations, public companies or IPO preparation, or post-acquisition integration is an advantage.
- Team or project management experience is an advantage; excellent communication and presentation skills in Hebrew and English are required.
This is an opportunity to apply the experience you have gained inside a technology company across multiple businesses and help build a service area at Deloitte, alongside finance and technology partners and specialists.
At Deloitte, we believe that diversity and inclusion among our people are critical to our success; therefore, we foster an organizational culture that embraces and values ​​diversity in all its forms.
Description Hebrew
Deloitte, פירמת השירותים המקצועיים המובילה בעולם, מחפשת מנהל/ת בתחום טרנספורמציית פיננסית.
דלויט מחפשת מנהל/ת עם ניסיון משמעותי במחלקת כספים של חברת טכנולוגיה, לתפקיד מרכזי בפיתוח פעילות ה־Finance Transformation שלנו במגזר.
התפקיד משלב היכרות עמוקה עם צורכי הכספים בחברות טכנולוגיה, התאמת היכולות והשירותים של הפרקטיקה לצרכים אלו, בניית קשרים עם מנהלי כספים והובלת פרויקטים — מזיהוי הצורך ועד למימוש הפתרון.
הפרקטיקה משלבת מומחיות פיננסית וחשבונאית עם הבנה מעשית בתהליכים, מערכות מידע וטכנולוגיה. אנו מסייעים למחלקות כספים לשפר את אופן הפעולה שלהן ולהתמודד עם צמיחה, פעילות גלובלית ושינוי עסקי.
מה כולל התפקיד
- היכרות עם סל השירותים והיכולות של הפרקטיקה והתאמתם לאתגרים ולסדרי העדיפויות של חברות טכנולוגיה, בשיתוף השותפים והמומחים המקצועיים.
- הובלת שיחות עם סמנכ״לי כספים וחשבים לזיהוי צרכים והזדמנויות, וגיבוש פתרונות ותוכניות עבודה שמתאימים לשלב ההתפתחות ולמורכבות של כל חברה.
- פיתוח קשרי לקוחות והזדמנויות עסקיות, בניית הצעות מקצועיות ומסחריות והשתתפות בתהליכי מכירה יחד עם השותפים.
- הובלת פרויקטים לשיפור תהליכי סגירה ודיווח, איחוד דוחות, מבנה חשבונות, בקרות ומודל ההפעלה של מחלקת הכספים.
- ליווי בחירה והטמעה של מערכות פיננסיות ו־ERP מצד הכספים, כולל הגדרת דרישות, שיפור תהליכים ושילוב אוטומציה, נתונים וכלי AI.
- ניהול צוותי פרויקט ואחריות לאיכות התוצרים, לעמידה בתכולה ובלוחות הזמנים ולקשר השוטף עם הלקוח, בשיתוף מומחים בארץ ובעולם.
Requirements Hebrew
- רישיון רו״ח וניסיון משמעותי כחשב/ת או עוזר/ת חשב בחברת טכנולוגיה — חובה.
- היכרות מעמיקה עם עבודת מחלקת הכספים בחברת טכנולוגיה: סגירה ודיווח, הכרה בהכנסה, בקרות, מערכות פיננסיות ועבודה מול ממשקים עסקיים.
- ניסיון אישי בהובלת שיפור או שינוי במחלקת כספים, כגון קיצור סגירה, שיפור דיווח, הטמעת מערכת או אוטומציה — חובה.
- יכולת לנהל שיח מקצועי עם מנהלי כספים, לזהות צורך ולתרגם אותו לפתרון ולהצעה ברורה.
- יוזמה עסקית, יכולת לבנות קשרים ורצון לקחת חלק בפיתוח פעילות ובהרחבת בסיס הלקוחות.
- אוריינטציה טכנולוגית ויכולת לעבוד עם מומחי מערכות, נתונים ואוטומציה.
- ניסיון בפעילות גלובלית, בחברות ציבוריות או לקראת הנפקה, או בשילוב חברות לאחר רכישה — יתרון.
- ניסיון בניהול צוותים או פרויקטים — יתרון; יכולות תקשורת והצגה מצוינות בעברית ובאנגלית — חובה.
זו הזדמנות לקחת את הניסיון שצברת בתוך חברת טכנולוגיה, להשפיע על מספר חברות ולהשתתף בבניית תחום פעילות בדלויט, לצד שותפים ומומחים בתחומי הכספים והטכנולוגיה.
אנו ב-Deloitte מאמינים כי גיוון והכלה בקרב אנשינו הם מרכיב קריטי בהצלחה שלנו, ולכן מטפחים תרבות ארגונית שמכילה ומאמצת גיוון על כל צורותיו.

jobs.title: Project Manager  – Compliance, Privacy & Technology Governance
jobs.description:
Description
We are seeking a highly skilled Project Manager – Compliance, Privacy & Technology Governance to lead projects across the domains of Compliance, Privacy, Regulation, Ethics, Information Security, and AI Governance.
In this role, you will lead cross-functional projects and processes, collaborating closely with legal, business, and technology interfaces.
﻿Key Responsibilities:
Project Leadership: Manage and lead end-to-end projects in the fields of compliance, privacy, regulation, ethics, information security, and risk management.
Privacy Verification & Reviews: Lead Privacy Verification and Privacy Review processes for products, systems, projects, and technological initiatives; this includes identifying privacy risks, documenting requirements, and tracking mitigation progress until full closure.
CIMP Process Management: Manage and lead CIMP (Confidential Information Management Program) processes for technological products and solutions, including AI-based systems, while evaluating privacy, confidentiality, data usage, information security, and regulatory compliance.
AI Governance & Risk: Support AI-driven initiatives and products regarding Privacy, Compliance, Confidentiality, and Risk, as part of AI Governance and risk management throughout the product lifecycle.
Ethics & Anti-Corruption Programs: Develop, implement, and manage internal processes to prevent corruption, bribery, and ethical violations across the organization.
Policy Formulation: Draft, implement, and manage organizational policies and procedures concerning compliance, ethics, Anti-Bribery and Corruption (ABC), privacy, and confidentiality.
Confidentiality & Data Protection Control: Oversee and control confidentiality processes and the protection of sensitive data, including reviewing confidentiality requirements in projects, products, and third-party engagements.
AML & Risk Monitoring: Monitor and control the implementation of AML (Anti-Money Laundering) and risk management processes, ensuring alignment with international regulatory standards.
Reporting & Training: Prepare comprehensive reports, working papers for executive management, privacy and compliance documentation, supervisory audit reports, and training programs.
Internal Audits: Conduct internal audits to identify, monitor, and mitigate compliance, privacy, confidentiality, ethics, and corruption risks.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Manage active working interfaces with Legal, Privacy, Information Security, IT, Product, Development, Operations, Regulation, and business stakeholders.
Tech-Driven PM Tools: Utilize advanced technological tools for project and process management, with an emphasis on Monday.com.
Requirements
- professional Experience: Proven experience in Compliance, Regulation, Privacy, Risk Management, or Project Management – Required.
- Experience and/or ability to work with AI tools – mandatory.
- Privacy & Information Security Knowledge: Solid understanding and experience in privacy and information security, including familiarity with relevant regulations such as GDPR and local privacy laws – Required (Significant Advantage).
- Privacy Risk Assessments: Experience or familiarity with PIA (Privacy Impact Assessment) or Privacy Review processes, and assessing privacy risks in products, systems, or processes – Significant Advantage.
- GRC & CIMP Familiarity: Familiarity with CIMP (Confidential Information Management Program) and/or GRC (Governance, Risk & Compliance) processes for technological products and solutions – Significant Advantage.
- AI Governance & Privacy: Familiarity with Privacy & AI Governance, including privacy, confidentiality, data usage, and risk management in AI-based products – Significant Advantage.
- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Experience working with IT, Product, Engineering, Information Security, and/or R&D teams – Advantage.
- Data Protection & Third-Party Risks: Familiarity with confidentiality processes, protection of sensitive data, and privacy considerations in third-party engagements – Advantage.
- Project Leadership: Strong ability to manage and lead complex projects with both internal and external stakeholders.
- Analytical Skills: Excellent risk analysis capabilities, strong attention to detail, and a proven track record of tracking processes and tasks through to full closure.
- Communication Skills: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
- Interpersonal Dynamics: Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a team-oriented environment.
- Language Proficiency: High-level English proficiency – Required.
Location: Tel Aviv
We at Deloitte believe that diversity and inclusion among our people is a critical component of our success, which is why we cultivate an organizational culture that embraces diversity in all its forms.

התפקיד כולל הובלת פרויקטים ותהליכים רוחביים מול ממשקים משפטיים, עסקיים וטכנולוגיים.
תחומי אחריות:

● הובלת תהליכי Privacy Verification ו־Privacy Review עבור מוצרים, מערכות, פרויקטים ויוזמות טכנולוגיות, לרבות זיהוי סיכוני פרטיות, תיעוד דרישות ומעקב אחר יישומן עד לסגירה מלאה.

● ליווי יוזמות ומוצרים מבוססי AI בהיבטי Privacy, Compliance, Confidentiality & Risk, כחלק מתהליכי AI Governance וניהול סיכונים לאורך מחזור חיי המוצר.
● פיתוח, יישום וניהול תהליכים למניעת שחיתות, שוחד והפרות אתיות בארגון.

● מעקב ובקרה על יישום תהליכי AML — מניעת הלבנת הון — וניהול סיכונים, תוך עמידה בדרישות רגולטוריות בינלאומיות.

● שימוש בכלים טכנולוגיים מתקדמים לניהול פרויקטים ותהליכים, לרבות Monday.com.

● היכרות עם CIMP ו/או תהליכי Governance, Risk & Compliance עבור מוצרים ופתרונות טכנולוגיים – יתרון משמעותי.
● היכרות עם Privacy & AI Governance, לרבות סוגיות פרטיות, סודיות, שימוש במידע וניהול סיכונים במוצרי AI – יתרון משמעותי.
● ניסיון בעבודה מול צוותי IT, Product, Engineering, Information Security ו/או R&D – יתרון.
● היכרות עם תהליכי סודיות, הגנה על מידע רגיש והיבטי פרטיות בהתקשרויות עם צדדים שלישיים – יתרון.

● יכולת ניתוח סיכונים, ירידה לפרטים ומעקב אחר תהליכים ומשימות עד לסגירתם.

● יכולת עבודה עצמאית לצד עבודת צוות.

jobs.title: Public Sector Junior Consultant
jobs.description:
Description
A Business Analyst in our Public Sector team works as part of project teams and supports consulting engagements through:
- Collecting, processing, and analyzing information
- Conducting in-depth research
- Preparing professional deliverables
- Building a high-quality, accurate knowledge base
The role enables the team to understand complex issues, identify initial insights, and develop potential directions for the client.
The position combines analytical work with ongoing engagement with professional stakeholders within the client organization. It requires collaboration with multiple organizational units, gathering information and insights from the field, understanding operational processes, and translating them into structured outputs that support decision-making and project advancement.
The role’s complexity stems from the need to quickly learn new subject areas, work with information from diverse sources, operate in a highly collaborative environment, and produce accurate deliverables under tight deadlines.
Key Responsibilities
- Prepare working materials and professional deliverables for the project team
- Document meetings, interviews, and workshops
- Produce summaries and identify key insights
- Conduct background research and locate relevant information based on project needs
- Work with professional stakeholders within the client organization to collect information, coordinate activities, and advance tasks
- Identify information gaps and raise them with the project team
- Serve as a ministry liaison within the project, working on an ongoing basis as part of the client team, typically in planning and performance-monitoring processes
Requirements
Requirements
- Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field — required
- Interest in the public sector and work that creates social impact
- High motivation to work in a complex environment with multiple stakeholders
- Ability to quickly learn organizational processes and new subject areas
- Ability to collect, organize, and analyze qualitative and quantitative information
- Strong attention to detail, organization, and commitment to high-quality deliverables
- Ability to work in multidisciplinary teams and with diverse stakeholders
- Good writing and communication skills, along with the willingness and ability to quickly learn professional standards for developing deliverables
- Strong technical proficiency in Microsoft Office tools, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint, as well as experience working with AI tools - mandatory
We at Deloitte believe that diversity and inclusion among our people is a critical component of our success, which is why we cultivate an organizational culture that embraces diversity in all its forms.
Description Hebrew
 ביזנס אנליסט/ית משתלב/ת בצוותי פרויקט ותומך/ת בעבודת הייעוץ באמצעות איסוף, עיבוד וניתוח מידע, ביצוע מחקרי עומק והכנת תוצרים מקצועיים.
התפקיד מתמקד בבניית בסיס ידע איכותי ומדויק שמאפשר לצוות להבין סוגיות מורכבות, לזהות תובנות ראשוניות ולגבש כיווני חשיבה עבור הלקוח. 
התפקיד כולל שילוב בין עבודה אנליטית לבין עבודה שוטפת מול גורמי מקצוע בארגון הלקוח. במסגרת הפרויקטים נדרש/ת בעל/ת התפקיד לקיים ממשקי עבודה עם יחידות שונות בארגון, לאסוף מידע ותובנות מהשטח, להבין תהליכי עבודה ולהפוך אותם לתוצרים מובנים התומכים בקבלת החלטות ובקידום הפרויקט. רמת המורכבות בתפקיד נובעת מהצורך ללמוד במהירות עולמות תוכן חדשים, לעבוד עם מידע ממקורות מגוונים, להשתלב בסביבה מרובת ממשקים ולהפיק תוצרים ברמת דיוק גבוהה תחת לוחות זמנים קצרים.
תכולות התפקיד :
• הכנת חומרי עבודה ותוצרים מקצועיים עבור צוות הפרויקט 
• תיעוד פגישות, ראיונות וסדנאות והפקת סיכומים ותובנות מרכזיות 
• ביצוע מחקרי רקע ואיתור מידע רלוונטי בהתאם לצורכי הפרויקט
 • עבודה מול גורמי מקצוע בארגון הלקוח לצורך איסוף מידע, תיאומים וקידום משימות. 
• זיהוי פערי מידע והצפתם לצוות הפרויקט
 • רפרנט משרדי תחת פרויקט – עבודה שוטפת כחלק מצוות הלקוח (לרוב תהליכי תכנון ובקרה) 
Requirements Hebrew
דרישות התפקיד
- תואר ראשון בתחום רלוונטי – חובה
- זיקה לעולם הציבורי ולעשייה בעלת השפעה חברתית
- מוטיבציה גבוהה לעבודה בסביבה מורכבת ורבת ממשקים
- יכולת למידה מהירה של תהליכים ארגוניים ועולמות תוכן
- יכולת איסוף, ארגון וניתוח מידע איכותני וכמותי
- דיוק, סדר ועמידה בסטנדרטים גבוהים של איכות תוצר
- יכולת עבודה בצוותים רב־תחומיים ומול גורמים מגוונים
- יכולת כתיבה וניסוח ברמה טובה, לצד נכונות ויכולת ללמוד במהירות סטנדרטים מקצועיים של בניית תוצרים
- שליטה טכנית טובה בכלי Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint...), וניסיון ו/או יכולת עבודה עם כלי AI - חובה

jobs.title: Risk Consultant
jobs.description:
Description
Deloitte, the world's leading professional services firm, is looking for a Risk Consultant.

Description
At Natural Intelligence, we are on a mission to simplify decision-making for millions. We build leading comparison websites that connect high-intent consumers with the world's top brands. Since 2009, we've grown into a bootstrapped, profitable powerhouse in the performance marketing industry.
We are looking for an Office Manager to join our People Operation team. You’ll work closely with our People Operations & Employee Experience team to help keep office life running smoothly.
This is a full-time, fully on-site role at our Tel Aviv office, Sunday to Thursday, 9:00 AM-6:00 PM.
﻿The role reports to the Head of People Operations & People Experience.
Your Impact
- Reception & Employee Service: Manage the front desk, welcome guests, respond to employee requests, coordinate meeting room bookings, and handle incoming mail and deliveries.

jobs.title: Business Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Description
Come and join a rapidly expanding mobile games company!
Who are we?
SuperPlay is a leading gaming company dedicated to creating unforgettable mobile gaming experiences. Founded in 2019 by industry experts from Playtika and Rovio, the company strives to develop innovative and exciting casual games that captivate millions of players worldwide and remain enjoyable for years to come.
Dice Dreams, our flagship game, has become a global sensation and a top-100-grossing hit, while Domino Dreams, our next big success, is also making a significant impact in the industry.
Our Newest Game – A Magical Collaboration with Disney!
Released in 2025, Disney Solitaire brings beloved Disney stories and characters to life in an unforgettable gaming experience.
Our team, headquartered in Tel Aviv, is made up of talented, passionate, and ambitious professionals. And the future is even more exciting! Want to be part of our journey? Check out the job description below.
What will you do at SuperPlay?
We have petabytes of data, but data isn't insight. Your mission is to be the bridge between raw information and strategic action. This isn't about being a "dashboard provider" - you will be measured by the quality of insights you generate; it's about creating "aha!" moments by going beyond the "what" to uncover the "why" that drives player behavior and shapes our success.
This role is unique: our data is exceptionally clean. There is no ETL or technical pipeline maintenance. Our time is almost exclusively spent on thinking, brainstorming, learning, and researching.
In this role, you will:
- Be a strategic partner to our product, design, and leadership teams. Your job is to bring them not just answers, but better questions. You'll translate your findings into compelling, actionable recommendations that catalyze new features, better experiences, and smarter business decisions.
- Hypothesize, test, and build frameworks to understand how virtual economies thrive and how player incentives drive long-term engagement.
- Embark on deep research projects to deconstruct our most complex business questions. Your deliverable will be a compelling narrative, backed by rigorous analysis, that guides our strategic business roadmap.
- Focus on what’s important. We use modern tools (like LLMs) for brainstorming and automating the mundane. Your focus will be on the ambiguous, the complex, and the truly innovative.
Who are you?
Our definition of a good analyst is simple: someone who provides decision-makers with interesting insights.
There are varied archetypes and backgrounds that fit this definition, but some core traits are universal:
- 2+ years of experience in the gaming industry/ more than 3 years of experience in Monetization.
- You are a first-principles thinker with an innate need to break down complex problems to their fundamental truths.
- You possess a deep-seated curiosity to understand human behavior.
- You develop strong, data-informed opinions and aren't afraid to voice them. However, you are eager to be challenged and ready to be convinced by new evidence or a better argument.
- You can effortlessly translate a complex statistical model into a clear, persuasive story for any audience, with an emphasis on C-level executives.
- You are resourceful and self-driven, comfortable navigating uncertainty and motivated to find a path forward even when the way isn't clear
You get bonus points for:
The journey from a complex question to a clear insight is often accelerated by the right tools. Experience with the following is useful for this role (though not required):
- A solid understanding of experimental design and A/B testing methodologies.
- Proficiency in querying and manipulating large datasets (e.g., strong SQL skills).
- Experience using a scripting language like Python for data analysis and automation.
- Familiarity with user analytics platforms (e.g., Mixpanel).
- Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Looker).

jobs.title: Product Manager, AI Security
jobs.description:
Description
About Cyera
Come join the company building the security operating model for the age of AI.
AI has changed how data is used - and security must change with it. Cyera's mission is to empower businesses to accelerate AI Adoption by defining a holistic approach to securing AI - from data to access to model. Instead of perimeter controls and static policies, Cyera provides a unified control plane that understands relationships between data, access, and behaviors across humans, systems, and AI. Backed by the world’s leading investors and working with a large and growing list of Fortune 1000 companies, we are looking for world-class talent to join us as we usher in the new era of data and AI security.
About the Role
Earlier this year, Cyera established an entirely new group with a singular focus: Enabling our customers to safely adopt AI. Not just secure AI use after the fact - but discover it, govern it, and protect it end to end.
You'll join this group as we define what enterprise-grade AI security looks like from scratch. The work spans detection and classification of AI usage across the enterprise, governance frameworks for AI agents and models, and the controls that let security teams move as fast as the technology they're protecting against. The market is moving fast - new models, new attack surfaces, new regulatory pressures, new customer needs - and keeping up isn't optional. You'll need to live at the edge of what's happening, synthesize signal from noise, and turn it into product decisions before others have even framed the question.
This is a rare role: Deeply strategic, deeply technical, and deeply consequential.
﻿What You’ll Do
- You'll own product initiatives across the AI security lifecycle - from how enterprises discover AI sprawl across their environments, to how they govern AI agent behavior, to how they enforce data protection in a world where models are the new attack surface. 
- You'll work across the full spectrum - partnering with world-class R&D teams pushing the boundaries of what's technically possible, engaging CISOs and security architects at Fortune 500 companies globally to understand real-world constraints, and collaborating with GTM to translate customer needs into product direction. The environment is fast, sometimes chaotic, and genuinely exciting - the kind of place where the problem space shifts under your feet and that's a feature, not a bug.
Requirements
Who You Are
Must-Haves
- You have a strong track record in B2B product management - ideally in security, data, or enterprise SaaS - but specific knowledge of any of these domains is less critical than authentic curiosity and a proven track record of building great products in a dynamic environment.
- Exceptional product taste and passion for creating delightful product experiences.
- You understand how large organizations actually operate: The compliance pressures, the procurement cycles, the gap between what security teams want and what they can deploy.
- You have a clear point of view on AI and where enterprise security is headed.
- You're as comfortable in a whiteboard session with an enterprise architect as you are deep in a research paper because something just dropped that changes everything.
- You thrive on ambiguity, move with urgency, and find energy in the pace rather than fighting it.
- You are excited about the opportunity to join a team of high performers in a high pressure environment and take an active role in contributing to the success of Cyera and our customers.
﻿Why Join Us?
At Cyera, we own what we build and how we work. Cyerans are empowered to take initiative, move quickly, and turn ideas into impact.
We push boundaries by challenging the status quo, learning fast, and continuously raising the bar - for ourselves and for the industry.
We elevate together by lifting each other up, celebrating wins as a team, and recognizing that our success is shared.
Feel free to apply even if your experience doesn’t tick every box.
We’re building something special here—and we welcome Cyerans with diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences.

jobs.title: NPI Engineering Build Manager
jobs.description:
We are seeking an NPI Engineering Build Manager who is passionate about working on products that enable deep learning. Our team manages the NPI networking supply chain for engineering activities. Activities start from very early engagement with design engineering team and follow through all quick turn NPI builds at the shortest possible cycle time. Our team supports all these engineering quick turn activities by engaging with the engineering team, material suppliers, Operations team, and the PCB manufacturing team. All the parties need to be kept aligned while engineering keeps changing either the material sets or the process.
We are looking for someone can work in a dynamic and fast-changing environment. You are someone who enjoys working on groundbreaking technology and enjoy working with people to take on problems. As a Build Project Manager, you are able to see both the high-level view and be proficient in tracking and following up on detail whether it is an existing product that requires new qualifications or a ground up new product. We will expect you to understand technical detail and be able to translate that into program impact.
What you'll be doing:
Build project's production plan per product's lifecycle, and execute it with NV manufacturers
Communicate with other team members and suppliers to get project details, and flexibility to adapt to changing requirements, diverse project needs, and tight timelines.
Ability to report on program details in Alignment meetings.
Track and communicate key deliverables, constraints, risks, dependencies and clearly identify critical paths while working with ASIC, product, test, software, board, system engineering and planning teams and other program managers towards a common goal.
Manage cross-functional communications independently, work within a matrixed and publish progress/roadblocks and highlight risks to upper management.
Bring diverse and globally distributed teams together to tackle complex problems and work towards closure.
Lead and attend cross-functional NPI meetings related to your product and highlight key Ops issues while ensuring that the product is ready for production.
Be an active participant in the NPI team by recommending methodology improvements that we can practice as a team.
Requirements: 
 What we need to see:
B.Sc. in Industrial Engineering, or equivalent experience.
2+ years experience in a similar role, preferably within an engineering, manufacturing/operations environment.
Ability to track multiple projects simultaneously.
Good interpersonal skills are important to your success and knowing when to engage stakeholders for making decisions or resolving issues.
Excellent leadership, communication, problem-solving, decision-making, and cross-functional influencing skills.
Ability to analyze and solution supply chain processes.
Excellent knowledge of semiconductor manufacturing flow and processes with proven program management capability.
Concise and actionable communications are also important.
Ways to stand out from the crowd:
Prior experience in semiconductor, interconnect, board, or system NPI.
Working knowledge of SAP.
Strong collaborative and social skills, and ability to effectively guide and influence within a dynamic, multifaceted environment.
Multifaceted environment.
This position is open to all candidates.

jobs.title: דרוש /ה פלנר /ית ייצור (תפ"י)
jobs.description:
דרוש/ה פלנר/ית ייצור (תפ"י)
אוהבים לתכנן, לפתור בעיות ולראות את התוצאות בשטח?
לתפקיד משמעותי במערך הייצור דרוש/ה פלנר/ית ייצור לתכנון ותזמון הייצור במספר מחלקות, תוך איזון בין תוכניות העבודה, אילוצי הייצור ויעדי האספקה.
התפקיד משלב חשיבה אנליטית, תעדוף משימות ועבודה מול ממשקים רבים, עם השפעה ישירה על רציפות הייצור ועל עמידה בלוחות הזמנים.
מה כולל התפקיד?
- בניית תוכניות ייצור שבועיות וחודשיות בהתאם להזמנות, לתחזיות, לקיבולת הייצור ולזמינות החומרים.
- תכנון ותזמון משימות הייצור ומעקב אחר ביצוע התוכניות.
- זיהוי פערים בין התכנון לביצוע, טיפול בצווארי בקבוק ומתן מענה לשינויים ולאילוצים בזמן אמת.
- מעקב אחר מועדי אספקה ועדכון תוכניות העבודה בהתאם לצורך.
- עבודה שוטפת מול מחלקות הייצור, הרכש, הפיתוח והאיכות לקידום פתרונות ולשיפור תהליכי התכנון והבקרה.
דרישות:
 מה נדרש?
ניסיון של שנתיים לפחות בתפקיד בסביבה תעשייתית.
תואר בהנדסת תעשייה וניהול.
שליטה טובה באנגלית.

חשיבה אנליטית, סדר ודיוק, ראייה מערכתית ויכולת תעדוף ועבודה מול ממשקים מרובים.
יודעים להפוך תוכניות עבודה לתוצאות ולמצוא פתרונות גם כשהתוכניות משתנות? נשמח להכיר! המשרה מיועדת לנשים ולגברים כאחד.

jobs.title: אחראי /ת פרויקטי גמר לתואר ראשון ביה"ס להנדסת תעשייה ומערכות נבונות
jobs.description:
ריכוז, ניהול ופיתוח פעילות פרויקטי הגמר בבית הספר, לרבות גיבוש תהליכי עבודה וליווי שוטף של כלל הגורמים המעורבים. ייזום, פיתוח וטיפוח קשרי עבודה ושיתופי פעולה עם גורמי חוץ בתעשייה, בארגוני שירות, במוסדות ציבוריים ובאקדמיה, לצורך איתור וקידום פרויקטים. בחינה, אישור והקצאת פרויקטים לסטודנטים ולמנחים, ומעקב אחר התקדמותם לאורך שלבי הביצוע השונים. קיום קשר שוטף עם מנחי הפרויקטים ועם אנשי הקשר בארגונים השותפים, ומתן מענה מקצועי ותפעולי בהתאם לצורך. ניהול ותפעול אתר הקורס ומעקב אחר פעילות צוותי הפרויקטים בהתאם למתודולוגיות העבודה שנקבעו. תכנון, ארגון וריכוז אירועי הצגת פרויקטי הגמר, לרבות ימי מצגות, תערוכות סוף שנה ואירועים פקולטיים. ייזום ימי מצגות סטודנטים, הרצאות אורח ופעילויות אקדמיות משלימות בתחום הפרויקטים. ייצוג בית הספר מול יחידות הפקולטה והאוניברסיטה וקידום שיתופי פעולה פנים-ארגוניים. ביצוע מטלות נוספות בהתאם להנחיית הממונים.
דרישות:
 תואר שני בהנדסה או במדעים מדויקים. תואר בהנדסת תעשייה וניהול - יתרון. היכרות עם התעשייה ויכולת לפתח ולקיים קשרי עבודה עם ארגונים רלוונטיים בתחומי הנדסת תעשייה ומערכות, בדגש על מערכות ביטחוניות, מערכות בריאות וארגונים מובילים במשק. ניסיון בהוראה, בהדרכה ו/או בליווי פרויקטים אקדמיים או מקצועיים - יתרון. יכולת ייזום, הובלת תהליכים ופיתוח שיתופי פעולה. יכולת עבודה עצמאית והשתלבות בצוות. ידיעת השפה העברית על בוריה וידיעת השפה האנגלית ברמה טובה מאד, לרבות יכולת הבעה ותכתובת בשפות אלה. יכולת למידה עצמית של נושאים מורכבים והתעדכנות מקצועית. יכולת ארגון, תכנון, תיאום ומעקב ברמה גבוהה. יכולת התמודדות עם עומס משימות ועמידה בלוחות זמנים. תודעת שירות גבוהה ויחסי אנוש מעולים. הערה: נדרשת נכונות לעבודה בשעות נוספות עפ"י הצורך. כפיפות: אחראי אקדמי של קורס הפרויקט ולראשת המינהל. המשרה מיועדת לנשים ולגברים כאחד.

jobs.title: הנדסאי/ת תעשייה וניהול - תפ"י
jobs.description:
הנדסאי/ת תעשייה וניהול לתפקיד תפי | עיבוד שבבי | אחריות על תכנון הייצור מקצה לקצה 
לחברה יצרנית בתחום העיבוד השבבי דרוש/ה איש תפי לתכנון ולבקרה של תהליכי הייצור, מקבלת הזמנת הלקוח ועד לאספקתה.
משרה מלאה באזור המרכז. לאחר שנה מתוכנן מעבר לקריית גת.
מה מייחד את התפקיד?
- אחריות רציפה על תוכנית הייצור לאורך מחזור ההזמנה.
- שילוב בין תכנון וניתוח נתונים לבין נוכחות קבועה ברצפת הייצור.
- עבודה מקצועית עם מנהל המפעל וממשקי טכנולוגיה, ייצור, איכות, רכש ולוגיסטיקה.
מה כולל התפקיד?
- הזנת הזמנות ודרישות אספקה למערכת, פתיחת פקודות עבודה ומעקב אחר ביצוען.
- הכנת תוכניות ייצור שבועיות וחודשיות בהתאם לעומסים ולסדרי העדיפויות.
- תזמון העבודה בין מחלקות החריטה, הכרסום, ההשחזה, הביקורת וההרכבה, ובין תהליכי הייצור החיצוניים.
- בקרה על התקדמות הייצור ביחס לתוכנית ועל זמינות חומרי גלם, כלים, מתקנים ותיקי ייצור.
- זיהוי חוסרים, עיכובים וצווארי בקבוק; מעקב אחר הזמנות פתוחות, הזמנות בפיגור והזמנות שבסיכון.
- מעקב אחר עבודות קבלני משנה ובקרה על מלאי חומרי הגלם, המלאי בתהליך והתוצרת המוגמרת.
- ריכוז וניתוח נתונים על זמני ייצור, תפוקות וניצולת מכונות.
- עבודה שוטפת מול מנהל המפעל, טכנולוגים, מנהלי מחלקות, איכות, רכש ולוגיסטיקה, כולל נוכחות ברצפת הייצור.
להגשת מועמדות לשלוח קוח למייל.
דרישות:
 מה נדרש?
- השכלת הנדסאי/ת תעשייה וניהול. ניתן לשקול גם מהנדס/ת תעשייה וניהול או השכלה רלוונטית אחרת עם ניסיון מתאים.
- התמחות במערכות ייצור - יתרון.
- ניסיון של כשנתיים לפחות בתפי בסביבה יצרנית.
- ניסיון בעיבוד שבבי או בייצור מורכב.
- ניסיון בתכנון תוכניות ייצור, בניהול עומסים ובמעקב אחר פקודות עבודה.
- ניסיון במערכות ERP /MRP ובמערכת קיטרון (Kitaron).
- שליטה טובה מאוד ב-Excel והבנת תהליכי ייצור ושרטוטים לצורכי תכנון ובקרה.
- יכולת לעבוד עם נתונים רבים, לטפל במספר משימות במקביל ולקבוע סדרי עדיפויות.
- עברית ברמה גבוהה ואנגלית טכנית טובה. המשרה מיועדת לנשים ולגברים כאחד.

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager
jobs.description:
As a Technical Project Manager at Jeen, you will lead the delivery of enterprise-grade AI projects from planning through execution. Youll work closely with customers, engineering, and cross-functional teams to ensure smooth technical integrations, clear communication, and on-time delivery. This role combines strong project management skills with a solid technical background, enabling you to translate complex requirements into successful, scalable AI solutions in a fast-growing, innovative environment.
Lead complex implementations, own client relationships, and drive innovation in fast-paced environments where your technical expertise creates real business impact.
Responsibilities
Lead and manage full-cycle implementation projects, from planning to go-live
Own the client relationship from a technical perspective- requirements, customizations, installations, and version updates.
Oversee the installation of JEENs platform across dev, test, and production environments, including integration with client systems.
Collaborate with IT stakeholders and internal engineering teams.
Coordinate cross-functional project roles in a matrix environment.
Create detailed project plans, track progress, and ensure on-time delivery.
Manage and execute version updates and technical change processes with the client.
Requirements: 
 2+ years of experience managing technical projects in enterprise environments.
3+ years of hands-on development experience in data or digital domains.
Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Industrial Engineering, or equivalent experience.
A proven ability to deliver complex technical projects in fast-paced environments.
Deep understanding of integration solutions and diverse IT systems.
Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills.
Experience with AI-related projects- a plus.
Familiarity with large language models (LLMs) - a plus.
This position is open to all candidates.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
The Project Manager leads a cross-functional/multidisciplinary team of Leaders and their respective project teams for PET programs in Haifa, to deliver project objectives., The program manager drives clarity by continuously defining and prioritizing work, defines the critical success factors/deliverables for the team.
Job Description
Duties include (but are not limited to):
1. Overall responsibility for program success providing engineering innovation within time, budgetary, quality and performance constraints and guidance to continuously deliver products directly supporting the overall business strategy. 
2. Creates and ensures effective and efficient communication across business functions. 
3. Applies leadership to motivate and energize the variety of cross-functional teams consisting of the program. 
4. Works closely and transparently with Product Leadership and Business Leadership to align program with market dynamics and drive program direction.
5. Leads cross-functional and/or multi-disciplinary program planning, drives the team to generate trade-offs and identify and manage risks from the early planning phase, throughout the entire program execution. 
6. Works as an equal partner with the program team to deliver results, understands and openly supports all functional goals.
7. Solves complex and ambiguous problems, leads the strategic and forward-thinking program execution including (but not limited to) concept discussion, program execution, rollout, training, pilot trials, clinical evaluations until successful deployment to serial production. 
8. Works with customers to solicit input and feedback to meet quality and customer expectations.
9. Provides expert guidance and support to the program organization in various technical/functional aspects.
10. Creates and supports the stewardship of intellectual property with appropriate security of project documentation.
Requirements: 
 1. Bachelors Degree within appropriate Engineering/Science discipline with at least 2 years of cross-functional Project and/ or Technical Leadership experience.
2. Minimum of 5 years of experience in program management or project leadership of multi-disciplinary systems within a development, technical industry, manufacturing and/or research environment.
3. Demonstrated execution at meeting project goals while satisfying quality, performance, schedule, and budget CTQs.
4. Demonstrated engineering knowledge, program management, and business planning processes, having experience with the full product lifecycle from concept through end of life.
5. Familiarity with IEC, FDA EMC, and other regulatory standards.
This position is open to all candidates.

jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
The Program Manager will ensure predictable, coordinated, and transparent delivery between Product and R&D, from release planning through launch. The role connects product and engineering teams, establishing effective ways of working, managing dependencies and priorities, and maintaining clear communication with relevant stakeholders.
Key Responsibilities
Lead release planning, readiness, and launch processes in close collaboration with Product and R&D teams.
Manage release plans and track release readiness, dependencies, blockers, risks, and delivery milestones.
Create, consolidate, and distribute clear and accurate release notes.
Facilitate sprint opening, ongoing tracking, and closure, including monitoring tasks, statuses, and delivery objectives.
Work closely with Engineering Team Leads, Product Managers, and cross-functional stakeholders across the company.
Support prioritization and alignment across business, product, and technical needs.
Establish and continuously improve operating processes, ceremonies, and tracking tools to enable efficient and predictable delivery.
Identify blockers, drive their resolution, and provide transparent updates on program and release progress.
Requirements: 
 Requirements
2-3 years of experience in project management or program management within an R&D or product environment.
Experience working with Agile methodologies and managing sprint cycles.
Hands-on experience with Jira and similar project tracking tools.
Strong ability to manage priorities, dependencies, and multiple stakeholders.
Excellent organizational, interpersonal communication, and process-driving skills.
Technical background and an understanding of software development processes.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in a SaaS or B2B environment.
Experience leading Release Management processes.
A relevant degree, such as Information Systems, Industrial Engineering and Management, or a related field.
This position is open to all candidates.

jobs.title: Information Systems & AI Automation Manager
jobs.description:
We are looking for a highly motivated Information Systems & AI Automation Manager to lead the evolution of our internal systems, business applications, and AI-powered automation initiatives. 
 This is a unique opportunity to play a key role in shaping how technology enables the business. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to improve operational efficiency, optimize processes, integrate systems, and leverage AI to create smarter ways of working. 
 The ideal candidate is both strategic and hands-on, combining strong technical expertise with a deep understanding of business processes and a passion for innovation.
Requirements: 
 :Key Responsibilities Information Systems Management Own and manage the company's internal business systems, SaaS platforms, and operational tools. Lead the implementation, configuration, integration, and continuous improvement of business applications. Ensure system reliability, user access management, data integrity, and operational excellence. Partner with internal stakeholders and external vendors to align systems with evolving business needs. Identify opportunities to simplify technology stacks, enhance data quality, and improve system efficiency. AI & Business Process Automation Drive the organization's AI and automation strategy by identifying high-impact opportunities across business functions. Design, build, and maintain automated workflows using platforms such as n8n, Make, Zapier, or similar tools. Implement AI-powered solutions using leading LLM technologies including OpenAI, Claude, and related AI platforms. Develop intelligent agents, assistants, and workflow automations to support business operations. Integrate business systems through APIs, webhooks, and automation frameworks. Automate repetitive and manual processes across departments including Operations, Finance, HR, Customer Success, and Sales. Monitor, measure, and optimize automation initiatives based on efficiency gains, cost savings, quality improvements, and business impact. Systems Integration & data Management Build and maintain integrations across internal and external platforms using APIs and modern integration technologies. Work with structured and unstructured data to support automation and AI-driven initiatives. Ensure proper governance, security, privacy, and compliance standards are maintained across systems and AI implementations. Troubleshoot and continuously improve system integrations and workflow reliability. Maintain clear documentation of system architecture, integrations, and automation processes. Business Partnership & Project Leadership Collaborate directly with business leaders to understand challenges, define requirements, and identify improvement opportunities. Translate business needs into scalable technical solutions. Lead technology and automation projects end-to-end, from discovery and design through implementation, testing, deployment, and support. Help drive AI adoption across the organization by enabling teams and promoting best practices. Remain up to date with emerging technologies, AI capabilities, automation tools, and industry trends.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager
jobs.description:
As a Product Manager at Limitless-Labs, you will lead the development of a one-of-a-kind AI Machining Agent, shaping a product at the intersection of AI, algorithms, and advanced manufacturing. You will deeply understand business goals and user needs in a complex, real-world environment, and work closely with AI, algorithms, and software teams to turn cutting-edge technology into a market-ready product.
This is an intensive and challenging role, where youll push the boundaries of whats possible alongside a top-tier, highly talented team. Youll combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution to deliver a best-in-class product that sets a new standard in the industry.
What Youll Do
Own the product vision and roadmap for our AI Machining Agent, from concept through launch and iteration.
Translate complex business, user, and manufacturing needs into clear product requirements and priorities.
Work hands-on with AI, algorithms, and software teams to define problems, design solutions, and deliver high-impact features.
Drive product discovery through user research, data analysis, and close collaboration with customers and internal stakeholders.
Make fast, high-quality decisions in a dynamic and ambiguous environment, balancing short-term execution with long-term strategy.
Define success metrics, track product performance, and continuously iterate to improve outcomes.
Act as the voice of the product, aligning engineering, leadership, and go-to-market teams around a shared vision.
Requirements: 
 A product manager / system engineer who thrives in complex, technical domains and enjoys turning ambiguity into clarity.
Comfortable working closely with engineers and domain experts. Able to hold meaningful conversations about technical trade-offs.
Driven by impact and ownership, with a strong bias toward execution and delivering real value to users.
Strategic in thinking, yet hands-on in practice - equally comfortable defining long-term vision and sweating the details
Curious, fast-learning, and excited by pushing the limits of what AI and manufacturing technology can do together.
Resilient and adaptable, with the ability to operate in an intensive, fast-paced environment.
A strong communicator who can align diverse stakeholders around a shared product direction.
This position is open to all candidates.

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
As a Business Analyst in our company Marketing, you will be a strategic partner, transforming data into impactful decisions that drive our North Star goal.
Key Responsibilities:
Strategic Insight & Recommendations: Drive decision-making by defining initiatives, measuring impact, and providing proactive recommendations from deep-dive analyses
Advanced Measurement & Metric Ownership: Research, define, and rigorously analyze key metrics, understanding root causes and ensuring valid, actionable measurement using statistical methods
AI/LLM Integration: Leverage Generative AI and Large Language Models to enhance data exploration, automate analysis, and accelerate insight generation
Full-Cycle Experimentation & A/B Testing: Lead the design, execution, and interpretation of A/B tests and experiments, guiding product and marketing strategy
User Journey & Funnel Optimization: Analyze complex user funnels and journeys to identify friction points and optimize paths for engagement and conversion
Audience Segmentation & Personalization: Develop and refine audience segments to optimize user experiences and improve the efficacy of product and marketing efforts
Expert SQL Development: Write, optimize, and maintain complex SQL queries to extract and transform data from diverse sources for analytical work
Data Enablement & Automation: Pioneer automated tools and build advanced dashboards to empower stakeholders with actionable insights and foster a data-fluent culture.
Requirements: 
 A highly analytical person with 2+ years of experience in quantitative analysis on large data sets, preferably from an online/tech company
Education in a field emphasizing quantitative analysis (such as industrial engineering, finance, statistics, economics, etc.)
Proficient in SQL - writing, optimizing, and managing complex queries
Advantage - Hands-on experience with Python/R for advanced analysis, or leveraging AI/ML/LLMs for insights as well as data visualization tools such as Tableau and Power BI
Excellent visualization and presentation skills
Highly independent, proactive, and a fast learner, capable of prioritizing in a dynamic environment and fostering cross-functional collaboration
English at a professional capacity and great communication skills, both in person and written
Have a solid understanding of A/B testing methodologies and statistical principles for effective experiment design, execution, and interpretation.
This position is open to all candidates.

jobs.title: Marketing Analyst
jobs.description:
As a Marketing Analyst , youll work closely with User Acquisition, Performance Marketing, Product, and Data teams to analyse acquisition performance, identify growth opportunities, and support data driven decision making across our platforms. Youll play a key role in measuring campaign performance, optimising acquisition funnels, and helping teams prioritise activities based on impact.
Responsibilities
Analyse Marketing and user acquisition performance across channels, campaigns, markets, audiences, and treatment categories
Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and KPIs to support acquisition and marketing decisions
Partner closely with User Acquisition and Performance Marketing teams to evaluate campaign performance and identify optimisation opportunities
Analyse the acquisition journey from advertising exposure to first completed purchase
Identify trends, bottlenecks, and growth opportunities across campaigns, landing pages, and conversion funnels
Analyse traffic quality and explain changes in acquisition volume, cost, and conversion
Evaluate the performance of channels, providers, campaigns, audiences, keywords, and creatives
Support the design, monitoring, and analysis of acquisition tests and experiments
Translate complex data into clear recommendations for cross functional stakeholders
Work with large datasets from multiple sources to ensure data accuracy and consistency
Support strategic decision making through data analysis, forecasting, and performance monitoring
Requirements: 
 2+ years of experience as a UA Analyst, Marketing Analyst, or in a similar analytical role
Strong SQL skills and experience working with large datasets
Experience with advertising platforms, attribution tools, Tableau, Mixpanel and GA4
Experience in B2C and large-scale platforms
Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills with a data driven mindset
Experience analysing acquisition funnels, campaign performance, traffic quality, and conversion metrics
Good understanding of digital acquisition channels, attribution, and performance marketing metrics
Excellent communication skills and ability to present insights to nontechnical stakeholders
Experience working in cross functional Agile environments
Advantage: experience in ecommerce, health tech, or telemedicine companies
This position is open to all candidates.

You'll keep portfolio data, reporting, and internal processes running smoothly across a diverse portfolio of innovative startups, with a focus on MedTech. This is an excellent opportunity to gain exposure to venture capital and portfolio management from the inside. This is a hybrid role, requiring three days in the office one day per week in our Jerusalem office and one day per week in our Tel Aviv office, and the third is flexible ; therefore, the position is posted in both locations.

 Maintain and update portfolio company records, KPIs, and performance data across internal systems and CRM. Track portfolio company updates, financial reports, and key milestones, and flag items that need the team's attention. Manage document flow and records, including shareholder documents, reporting requests, and internal approvals.  Bachelor's degree in business, economics, life sciences, or a related field. 1–2+ years' experience in an analyst, operations, finance, or business support role is an advantage; exposure to venture capital, private equity, or the startup ecosystem is an advantage. Familiarity with the MedTech or life sciences sector is an advantage. Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills and comfort working with data and financial information. Highly organized, with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Strong English proficiency, with excellent written communication skills. Tech-savvy, with the ability to quickly learn new tools and systems. Execute daily checkout procedures and maintain accurate electronic logs of trading issues, disputes, and resolutions.

* איסוף, עיבוד, ניתוח ובקרה של נתונים בתחום הרכש וההוצאות הארגוניות.
* בניית דוחות, ניתוח מגמות והפקת תובנות עסקיות לצורך ייעול תהליכים.

* בנייה ותחזוקה של דוחות ניהוליים ומדדי ביצוע (KPI).
* זיהוי חריגות, מגמות והזדמנויות להתייעלות על בסיס נתונים.
* ניתוח נתוני ספקים, עלויות והוצאות לצורך תמיכה בקבלת החלטות.
* שיתוף פעולה עם ממשקים ארגוניים לצורך איסוף נתונים, טיובם והצגתם.
* מעקב אחר ביצועים והצגת ממצאים ותובנות לגורמים הרלוונטיים בארגון.
דרישות:
 * תואר ראשון בכלכלה / מנהל עסקים / הנדסת תעשייה וניהול / מערכות מידע או תחום רלוונטי.
* ניסיון קודם בתפקיד אנליטי, כגון Data Analyst, BI Analyst או אנליסט/ית עסקי/ת – יתרון משמעותי.
* שליטה גבוהה ב-Excel, לרבות נוסחאות מתקדמות, Pivot Tables וניתוח נתונים – חובה.
* ניסיון בעבודה עם מערכות BI ובבניית דוחות – יתרון.
* ניסיון בעבודה עם מערכות ERP – יתרון.
* היכרות עם עולם הבריאות, בתי חולים או ארגונים רפואיים – יתרון משמעותי.
* יכולת אנליטית גבוהה, חשיבה ביקורתית, ירידה לפרטים ויכולת הסקת מסקנות מנתונים.
* יכולת עבודה עצמאית, סדר וארגון, יוזמה ותקשורת בין-אישית טובה.
מיקום: רמת החייל, תל אביב
היקף המשרה: משרה מלאה, ימים א׳–ה׳, 08:00–17:00
* המשרה מיועדת לנשים ולגברים כאחד.

 תואר ראשון רלוונטי- חובה. לפחות שנתיים ניסיון כData Analyst או BI Developer -חובה. שליטה גבוהה מאוד בSQL -חובה. ניסיון בפיתוח Universe ( SAP BO)- יתרון משמעותי. ניסיון ב-Tableau יתרון משמעותי. ניסיון בעבודה למול data Base של - Oracle יתרון משמעותי. ראייה עסקית חזקה ויכולת לתרגם צרכים עסקיים לפתרונות מבוססי דאטה. המשרה מיועדת לנשים ולגברים כאחד.

jobs.title: אנליסט/ית עסק/ית
jobs.description:
דרוש/ה אנליסט/ית עסק/ית
מה תעשו אצלנו?
תנתחו תוצאות ונתונים עסקיים, תסיקו מסקנות ותגבשו המלצות מבוססות נתונים להנהלה.
​​​​​ תאספו, תעבדו ותאמתו נתונים ממקורות פנימיים וחיצוניים
תאספו דרישות עסקיות ותתרגמו אותן למפרטים עסקיים וטכניים
תאפיינו ותפתחו כלים אנליטיים ופתרונות טכנולוגיים, לצד שיפור הכלים הקיימים
תעבדו בשיתוף פעולה עם חטיבות המכירות, השיווק, הסחר, מערכות המידע והכספים לשיפור תהליכים עסקיים.
תבצעו מחקרי שוק, תבחנו ביצועים ומתחרים ותזהו הזדמנויות וסיכונים.
תובילו פרויקטים בעולמות הדאטה מקצה לקצה - משלב הייזום והפיתוח ועד להשקה ותמיכה לאחריה.
תדריכו ממשקי עבודה על שימוש בכלים אנליטיים.
דרישות:
 תואר ראשון רלוונטי (סטטיסטיקה, תעו"נ) - חובה.
ניסיון של 1-3 שנים לפחות בעולמות האנליזה בארגון גדול - חובה.
אקסל ברמה גבוהה מאוד (כולל פונקציות מורכבות) - חובה.
הכרות ברמה טובה עם מערכת POWER-BI- חובה.
יכולת שיתוף פעולה ועבודה מול ממשקים רבים (רתימה של ממשקים).
אנגלית ברמה גבוהה. המשרה מיועדת לנשים ולגברים כאחד.

 לפחות תואר ראשון רלוונטי לפחות שנה ניסיון כ-Data Analyst ניסיון של שנה ב-SQL ניסיון עבודה מוסד פיננסי ידע / ניסיון ב-PowerBI – יתרון משמעותי תקשורת בין-אישית מצוינת ויכולת הצגת נתונים המשרה מיועדת לנשים ולגברים כאחד.
